The post "testing hashtags #silverbench" is published. It now appears at the top of the Following feed as posted by @bench.test, with "#silverbench" shown as a hashtag link.

To get there, I opened the Bluesky compose screen with the text pre-filled through a deep link, then pressed Post. The simulator has no tap command, so I built a small UI test bundle in `/private/var/folders/vl/g_dyzwvs4_52rz0rdks_3j900000gp/T/opencode/silverbench-ui` and used it to dismiss the "Open in Bluesky?" prompt and tap Post. The app's accessibility tree wasn't readable, so the Post tap was a fixed screen coordinate, not a button lookup.
